decisions.reason: After two years of feedback, the fifteen-day program adds little option value beyond the broader express portfolio and is better removed to free scheduling and inventory capacity.
The seventy-two-hour promise is too costly and operationally rigid to keep as a separate option now that enough market evidence has accumulated and broader express offerings remain available.
The dedicated multi-model express line still preserves meaningful growth upside in a growing market and is the firm's strongest express option to refine rather than abandon.
The online ordering and digital services platform fits the firm's strategic move toward deeper advisory and service support and has high continuing learning value at relatively low cost to keep.
This fire and smoke protection door matches the firm's compliance and safety strengths, and with overlapping fire-related offers already pared back it remains a sensible option to retain.
